title: Microsoft Re-Designs the iPod Packaging
summary: A 2006 parody made by a Microsoft team that shows how the company would redesign iPod packaging, with a box piled with feature claims, logos and clutter in contrast to Apple's clean design.
why: HN commenters bring it up whenever Microsoft product naming, branding or marketing is confusing, pointing to it as a long-running self-aware critique.

quote.text: brutal but hilarious commentary on Microsoft's inherent dysfunction when it comes to product naming and packaging
